notes:
Account: Litigantix (enterprise legal discovery provider). Primary contact: CTO Sarah Villanueva. Use-case: replace slow keyword-only search with vector-powered RAG for investigations and compliance reviews. They ingest mixed doc types (email, PDFs, TIFF OCR) ~50M docs; expect steady-state query volume 10k/day with bursts to 50k/day during litigation windows. Key metrics they care about: index build time, incremental update latency, embedding cardinality and storage, rerank latency (target p95 < 450ms), cost per query target <$0.02 (including embedding + rerank).

Deployment constraints: must run in customer VPC with private control plane; optional on-prem indexer appliance for high-sensitivity clients. KMS/HSM for key management. Retention + audit: 7+ year audit log retention, immutable retention windows, detailed per-request audit trails. Legal insisted on tenant isolation and ability to export immutable audit archives for regulators.

POC asks: 2-week POC to index 50M docs in VPC; benchmark p50/p95 latencies at 1k qps sustained, show cost modeling for 10k/day vs 50k/day. Also require a rerank ablation: compare embedding-only, BM25+rerank, hybrid cascade with early-exit and top-K re-rank.

Security notes: "We need KMS integration and proof of HSM-backed keys" — CTO quote from 2026-02-11 call. SOC2 and ISO27001 certificates requested; tighter retention controls + legal hold workflows required. Data residency: US only (some clients require specific state residency).

Internal: AE (Evan) pursuing executive sponsor (GC + Head of eDiscovery). SE (Priya) to run architecture workshop week of 2026-03-15. CSM (Jordan) placeholder if deal closes. Procurement expects 60-day lead time.

Next steps (short): send VPC architecture template, finalize POC SOW, provide cost model for three sizing scenarios, share SOC2 Type II artifacts, schedule infra workshop.

Quick friction points: budget cycles end of Q2; legal wants vendor attestation for immutable audit exports; customer insists on vector store encryption-at-rest with BYOK.
